'''Carnage119 Classic Court''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carnage119]]
* '''Published:''' 2 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]] (inferred from the title)

== Introduction ==

Non-flip Court deck following the classic environment rules.

The deck page itself was not captured by the Wayback Machine, so only the listing-page entry (title, author, date and blurb) survives; the card list is lost.


== Notes ==

* Listing-only entry: the GPN listing page 2 records this deck, but the deck page itself was never captured by the Wayback Machine (checked 11 October 2026), so the card list is lost. The side is inferred from the published title.
